name: Chinese Medicine & Acupuncture
whatsNew: Step into the clinic — three picture-flashcard decks (Foundations, Treatments, Herbs & Food Remedies) with the words behind qi, yin-yang, pulse-taking, acupuncture, cupping and the herbalist's drawers, plus three graded stories: a first visit to a Chinese doctor, Dad's first acupuncture session and Grandma's summer cooling tea.

cards.meaning: to have too much inner heat

sentences.chinese: 这几天我头疼，嗓子也疼，晚上睡不好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān wǒ tóuténg, sǎngzi yě téng, wǎnshang shuì bu hǎo.
sentences.english: These past few days I have had a headache, a sore throat, and I can't sleep well at night.

sentences.chinese: 妈妈说：“我们去看中医吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: “Wǒmen qù kàn zhōngyī ba.”
sentences.english: Mum said: "Let's go and see a Chinese medicine doctor."

sentences.chinese: 中医师让我坐下，把手放在我的手腕上，给我把脉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngyīshī ràng wǒ zuòxià, bǎ shǒu fàng zài wǒ de shǒuwàn shang, gěi wǒ bǎmài.
sentences.english: The doctor had me sit down, placed his fingers on my wrist and took my pulse.

sentences.chinese: 他又看了看我的舌头，说：“你上火了。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòu kàn le kàn wǒ de shétou, shuō: “Nǐ shànghuǒ le.”
sentences.english: Then he looked at my tongue and said: "You have too much inner heat."

sentences.chinese: 他给我开了一个药方，让我每天喝菊花茶，少吃辣的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ kāi le yí ge yàofāng, ràng wǒ měi tiān hē júhuāchá, shǎo chī là de.
sentences.english: He wrote me a prescription and told me to drink chrysanthemum tea every day and eat less spicy food.

sentences.chinese: 三天以后，我的头不疼了，晚上也睡得很好。
sentences.pinyin: Sān tiān yǐhòu, wǒ de tóu bù téng le, wǎnshang yě shuì de hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: Three days later my head no longer hurt, and I slept very well at night too.

questions.question: What was wrong with the narrator?
options: Headache, sore throat and poor sleep

questions.question: How did the doctor examine the narrator?
options: By taking the pulse and looking at the tongue

questions.question: What did the doctor tell the narrator to drink?

stories.title: 爸爸的第一次针灸
stories.titlePinyin: bàba de dì yī cì zhēnjiǔ

sentences.chinese: 爸爸每天坐在电脑前工作，最近他的腰很疼。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba měi tiān zuò zài diànnǎo qián gōngzuò, zuìjìn tā de yāo hěn téng.
sentences.english: Dad works at a computer every day, and lately his lower back has been very sore.

sentences.chinese: 朋友说针灸很有用，所以爸爸去了一家中医诊所。
sentences.pinyin: Péngyou shuō zhēnjiǔ hěn yǒuyòng, suǒyǐ bàba qù le yì jiā zhōngyī zhěnsuǒ.
sentences.english: A friend said acupuncture works well, so Dad went to a Chinese medicine clinic.

sentences.chinese: 医生先找到穴位，然后轻轻地扎针，一共扎了八根针。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng xiān zhǎodào xuéwèi, ránhòu qīngqīng de zhāzhēn, yígòng zhā le bā gēn zhēn.
sentences.english: The doctor first found the acupuncture points, then gently inserted the needles, eight in all.

sentences.chinese: 爸爸有点儿紧张，可是一点儿都不疼，只觉得有点儿麻。
sentences.pinyin: Bàba yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng, kěshì yìdiǎnr dōu bù téng, zhǐ juéde yǒudiǎnr má.
sentences.english: Dad was a little nervous, but it didn't hurt at all; he only felt a slight tingling.

sentences.chinese: 医生还在他的背上做了艾灸，暖暖的，很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng hái zài tā de bèi shang zuò le àijiǔ, nuǎnnuǎn de, hěn shūfu.
sentences.english: The doctor also did moxibustion on his back — warm and very comfortable.

sentences.chinese: 半个小时以后，爸爸站起来说：“我的腰轻多了！”
sentences.pinyin: Bàn ge xiǎoshí yǐhòu, bàba zhàn qǐlái shuō: “Wǒ de yāo qīng duō le!”
sentences.english: Half an hour later Dad stood up and said: "My back feels so much lighter!"

questions.question: Why did Dad's back hurt?
options: He sits at a computer all day

questions.question: How many needles did the doctor use?

sentences.chinese: 广州的夏天又热又湿，我一到奶奶家就觉得没有力气。
sentences.pinyin: Guǎngzhōu de xiàtiān yòu rè yòu shī, wǒ yí dào nǎinai jiā jiù juéde méiyǒu lìqi.
sentences.english: Summer in Guangzhou is hot and humid; the moment I arrive at Grandma's I feel drained.

sentences.chinese: 奶奶笑着说：“这是湿热，喝一碗凉茶就好了。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai xiào zhe shuō: “Zhè shì shīrè, hē yì wǎn liángchá jiù hǎo le.”
sentences.english: Grandma smiled and said: "That's damp heat — a bowl of cooling tea will sort it out."

sentences.chinese: 她从柜子里拿出菊花、甘草和几种我不认识的草药，放进锅里慢慢地煮。
sentences.pinyin: Tā cóng guìzi li ná chū júhuā, gāncǎo hé jǐ zhǒng wǒ bú rènshi de cǎoyào, fàng jìn guō li mànmàn de zhǔ.
sentences.english: She took chrysanthemum, liquorice root and several herbs I didn't recognise from the cupboard and simmered them slowly in a pot.

sentences.chinese: 凉茶很苦，我皱着眉头喝了一口，奶奶说：“良药苦口嘛！”
sentences.pinyin: Liángchá hěn kǔ, wǒ zhòu zhe méitóu hē le yì kǒu, nǎinai shuō: “Liángyào kǔkǒu ma!”
sentences.english: The tea was very bitter. I frowned and took a sip, and Grandma said: "Good medicine tastes bitter!"

sentences.chinese: 她告诉我，中医讲究养生：天气热的时候要清热，天气冷的时候要保暖。
sentences.pinyin: Tā gàosu wǒ, zhōngyī jiǎngjiu yǎngshēng: tiānqì rè de shíhou yào qīngrè, tiānqì lěng de shíhou yào bǎonuǎn.
sentences.english: She told me Chinese medicine is all about looking after your health: clear the heat when it's hot, keep warm when it's cold.

words.english: to pay attention to, to be particular about

sentences.chinese: 第二天我觉得精神多了，还学会了自己煮凉茶。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr tiān wǒ juéde jīngshen duō le, hái xuéhuì le zìjǐ zhǔ liángchá.
sentences.english: The next day I felt much more energetic, and I had learned to make cooling tea myself.
